title: graylog-5_1: remove
reason: Applicable: real graylog module + wired test. Real diff changes package's OWN declaration from a plain lib.mkOption (with a version-conditional default) to lib.mkPackageOption -- a clean, controlled natural experiment for the mkPackageOption gap, the OPPOSITE direction of olivetin's own transition (which went mkPackageOption -> plain mkOption).
targets_toml: single target graylog, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,graylog], watch=[package].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: STRONG CORROBORATING EVIDENCE for the mkPackageOption gap: the SAME option, in the SAME file, genuinely transitions from found-with-no-predicate (PredicateNotFound, correct) at base -- where it was a plain mkOption -- to completely undiscovered (OptionNotFound) at head, purely because the declaration helper changed to mkPackageOption. This is the cleanest, most controlled data point yet for this specific gap (tally: gonic/dex/n8n non-discovered as mkPackageOption from the start; olivetin went mkPackageOption->mkOption and became discoverable; graylog now shows the reverse transition and becomes undiscoverable) -- 5 total corroborating instances, 2 of them controlled before/after transitions in opposite directions.
